user.title: Add nutrient tank
user.description: New tanks monitor only. Refill requires explicit output selection, commissioning and a separate start request. Save/Cancel never actuates. EC must use mS/cm and level must use m.

error.invalid_max_age: Enter an integer from 10 to 86400 seconds.

init.title: Sources, outputs and nutrient safety settings
init.description: Save/Cancel never actuates. The operator verifies device protection, physical limits and sampling contracts; software does not certify them. The nutrient Switch remains unavailable until its engine is supported. Configured does not mean operational. EC uses mS/cm; level uses m.

data.commissioned: Verified physical identity, risks, OFF feedback and independent fail-safe
data.feedback_timeout: Feedback deadline (seconds; 10 is an engineering default, not an original-HA value)
data.refill_weekdays: Refill weekdays (empty forbids; P3 remains unavailable)
data.nutrient_weekdays: Nutrient weekdays (empty forbids; P3 remains unavailable)
data.acid_weekdays: Acid weekdays (empty forbids; P3 remains unavailable)
data.mix_weekdays: Mix weekdays (empty forbids; P3 remains unavailable)
data.nutrient_commissioned: I have verified the nutrient binding and its operating limits
data.nutrient_protection_confirmed: I have confirmed independent device maximum-ON protection
data.alias_notes: Verified physical identities and direct/timed aliases (not inferred by software)
data.sample_mode: EC sampling contract: reported, monotonic sequence, or ISO timestamp
data.sample_attribute: Explicit sample sequence/timestamp attribute (not a template)
data.report_contract_confirmed: Each HA report represents a genuinely new measurement
data.safe_min_level_m: Minimum safe dosing level (m; must be measured for this tank)
data.max_total_on_seconds: Conservative total ON budget per run (seconds, not mL)
data.ph_high_alarm: High-pH alarm threshold (not global emergency stop)

error.invalid_max_age: Enter an integer from 10 to 86400 seconds.
error.output_identity_invalid: Output registry identity is invalid or disabled. Re-verify it.
error.output_already_owned: Another tank owns this identifiable output.
error.control_busy: Disable master and confirm the run is stopped before rebinding/commissioning.
error.output_not_off: Old and new outputs must be known OFF; saving never closes them.
error.invalid_dosing_parameters: Provide the complete thirteen-key dosing settings.
error.invalid_dosing_parameter: Use a finite numeric value within the stated range and step, not Boolean.
error.nutrient_protection_unconfirmed: Confirm device protection, maximum ON and verified physical identities before commissioning.
error.sample_contract_unconfirmed: Confirm that each report is a new physical measurement.
error.invalid_sample_contract: Choose reported, sequence or timestamp with an explicit supported attribute.
error.invalid_dosing_relationship: Pulse/budget/deadline or target/danger limits are inconsistent.
error.settings_conflict: Settings changed since this form opened. Reopen and reconcile; nothing was saved.
error.entry_not_loaded: This tank is not currently loaded.
